title: 第11章 人皮面具第12章 三刀把头
lines: 林辰咳了一口血，气息又衰败了几分。
邢光远说的没错，林辰故意用了斩阵剑轮。
这一招，邢光远的领悟很深，是其招牌剑技！
而且林辰也了解邢光远的性格，知道邢光远一定想要用同样的招数将他碾杀，以此雪恨，让他更痛苦的死去。
而这，就是林辰的机会！
说到底，这剑招便是林辰教给邢光远的，又有谁比他对斩阵剑轮的理解更深？
杀掉邢光远，林辰快速检索其空间戒指。
刚才的动静不小，林辰担心引来其他人，必须马上离开。
“三品疗伤丹，品级不算高，但对恢复伤势帮助也不小！”
林辰眸光一闪。
直接吞服丹药，恢复伤势！
可惜，以邢光远的级别，能够弄到一枚空间戒指已经是不简单，品质自然不会太好，内部空间不大。
也仅仅是储备了两瓶丹药以及一些在外行走的器具而已，只能勉强应急。
“咦，这个是”
，林辰仔细翻找，却突然发现里面有一块皮质面具！
取出一看，林辰眼睛顿时一亮！
人皮面具！
邢光远手中竟有这种好东西，有了这个，林辰就可以改易容貌，隐藏身份！
而配合天钨的隐匿，林辰几乎可以做到不露破绽！
好东西！
当下林辰将人皮面具覆盖在脸上，然后注入玄力，缓缓揉搓，没一会儿，便化作了另一个人的脸！
成了一个陌生人！
“这样，海捕文书对我的威胁将大大减小，以后行动能保险许多”
，林辰稍显安心了几分。
接着，他看了一眼邢光远的尸体。
“倒是难为你大老远给我送来这面具，助我逃离”
，林辰淡漠开口。
随即，林辰将痕迹小心的清除干净，便迅速离去！
赵无极麾下怕是聚拢了不少林家昔日的旧部，寻过来的，不一定只有邢光远，林辰必须尽快远离这片区域。
然后，去寻山贼！
第二日，午后，林辰隐在一处密林阴影之中，看着远处一个山坳。
那里，有一群人在林中穿梭，身手矫健，凶神恶煞！
是山贼！
看来，距离他们的山寨不远了！
content_en:
Lin Chen coughed up a mouthful of blood, and his breath weakened a little more.
Xing Guangyuan was right, Lin Chen deliberately used the Zhan Zhan Sword Wheel.
Xing Guangyuan has a deep understanding of this move, and it is his signature sword skill!
Moreover, Lin Chen also understood Xing Guangyuan's character and knew that Xing Guangyuan would definitely want to use the same trick to crush him to death, so as to avenge him and make his death more painful.
And this is Lin Chen's opportunity!
After all, this sword move was taught to Xing Guangyuan by Lin Chen. Who else has a deeper understanding of the Zhan Zhan Sword Wheel than him?
After killing Xing Guangyuan, Lin Chen quickly retrieved his space ring.
There was a lot of commotion just now. Lin Chen was worried about attracting other people and had to leave immediately.
"The third-grade healing pill is not a high grade, but it is very helpful in recovering injuries!"
Lin Chen's eyes flashed.
Just swallow the elixir and recover from your injuries!
Unfortunately, with Xing Guangyuan's level, it is not easy to get a space ring. The quality will naturally not be very good, and the internal space is not large.
They only stocked two bottles of elixirs and some equipment for walking outside, so they could only be used as emergencies.
"Hey, this is"
, Lin Chen rummaged around carefully, but suddenly found a leather mask inside!
When he took it out and took a look, Lin Chen's eyes suddenly lit up!
Human skin mask!
Xing Guangyuan actually has such a good thing in his hands. With this, Lin Chen can change his appearance and hide his identity!
And with Tiantungsten's concealment, Lin Chen could almost avoid revealing any flaws!
nice one!
At that moment, Lin Chen covered his face with a human skin mask, then injected mysterious energy into it, and slowly rubbed it. After a while, it turned into another person's face!
Become a stranger!
"In this way, the threat to me from sea-trading documents will be greatly reduced, and my future actions will be much safer."
, Lin Chen felt a little relieved.
Then, he glanced at Xing Guangyuan's body.
"It's hard for you to come all the way to send me this mask to help me escape."
, Lin Chen said indifferently.
Immediately, Lin Chen carefully removed the traces and left quickly!
Zhao Wuji's subordinates may have gathered many old members of the Lin family, and Xing Guangyuan may not be the only one who comes here. Lin Chen must stay away from this area as soon as possible.
Then, go find the bandits!
On the second day, in the afternoon, Lin Chen hid in the shadow of a dense forest and looked at a mountain col in the distance.
There, there was a group of people walking through the forest, with strong skills and fierce looks!
It's a bandit!
It seems that their cottage is not far away!
